apps.name: Alarm Clock Planner
apps.tagline: Set an alarm for any date, not just this week.
apps.blurb: Alarms weeks or months ahead, monthly and yearly repeats, alarm groups and custom sounds. It rings on Silent, and no account is needed.
apps.why: I noticed how many people look for a better alarm app, then built it around my own mess: my wake-ups, family events, my daughter's after-school activities, and a quick 15-minute nap.

apps.name: Choru
apps.tagline: A family chore chart where every chore comes back when it's due.
apps.blurb: Daily dishes and the oven every three months share one list. A missed chore carries over as one row, and kids earn coins for rewards you pick.
apps.why: I wanted an easier way to run our family chores, and to motivate my daughter with rewards so she earns her screen time and toys.

apps.name: CharacterSheet
apps.tagline: Workouts, reading and meditation become XP. Level up in real life.
apps.blurb: Six stats, each from level 1 to 60. Finish quests, some of them hidden, and stack buffs for sleep, water and streaks. Skip a stat and it loses XP.
apps.why: I wanted to work out more and turn life into an RPG. I'm a looooong way from level 60, and that's the point: level 60 runs marathons.

apps.name: Scooch
apps.tagline: Will it fit? Draw your rooms to scale and know before you carry anything.
shot_alt: Scooch showing a sofa that does not fit in red
apps.blurb: Type a wall's length and it stays exact. 37 furniture pieces at real sizes turn red when they collide, and doors show the space they need to open.
apps.why: We rearrange our apartment every so often or think about an upgrade, and I needed to know if that IKEA wardrobe would actually fit.

apps.name: Rise
apps.tagline: Stop the alarm and your morning starts with a focus timer.
apps.blurb: The alarm rings even on Silent. Stopping it opens a short focus session on your Lock Screen, and every finished morning grows your streak.
apps.why: I wanted to get up early and build apps before work and family life start. Rise is the alarm that gets me out of bed to do it.

apps.name: Remi
apps.tagline: Reminders for an exact date, early March, or just someday.
apps.blurb: Pick early March, or just someday, when that is all you know. See your whole year at a glance, with eight widgets and a one-time unlock.
apps.why: My first app. I needed an easy way to track vaccines due years from now, and things like calling the dentist in two months.
